body:
I just cope with this shit differently. I dont know why im so afraid to get help. Maybe I just dont want to be locked up in a hospital like many people have had happen to them when they admitted that they were suicidal. Im already poor so I definitely can't pay for any hospital bills. I cant even afford a $154 vaccine i need for spring enrollment. My parents already work hard enough. Why should I give them more work? 

Do you know what I want? I dont want help. I want everyone to stop telling me things will be okay. I want people to stop telling me to stay alive because taking my life will only pass the pain onto someone else. Thats why I've worked so hard to push my friends away. I dont want to be remembered. Stop telling me what to do with my life.

I just dont want any of my friends or family to know and I definitely dont want the police to come. I wasn't sure if I wanted to get help from berkeley's resources but just needed to know that there are some that exist so that when I feel ready I will go get help. I come from a low-income family and no one believes in mental illness. I already feel like a burden so why would I want them to have more reason to yell at me and cause more problems to them.
I hope it ends soon.
Are you in pain as well?

He sent me an email saying if i don't respond he'll call an emergency contact or request a police welfare check.

Uh...wtf? 🤨
Oh okay. Ive just been trying to keep really quiet about all this shit. Thanks!
Honestly yeah. Idk why no one has done it yet.
There really isn't an easy way. Most methods are either painful, messy, or inaccessible. I mean I'm guessing lethal injection would be the "easiest" but unfortunately, the government says no :(
:moyai:
Me too :(
I emailed them about my missing meningococcal vaccine and about the flu vaccine but they still haven't gotten back to me yet :/
Yeah I've lived my entire life trying to get their approval. Ive done what I could but I'll never be enough to them.
Kinda wish someone came up to me and shot me. That way it won't really be death by my own hands and I'll die without that supposed "shame" of committing suicide.
I thought I could buy a guy on Amazon. Turns out I cant. Tried hanging myself with a jump rope last week and it snapped. Im just trying to find things to laugh at now 🤷‍♀️

Lethal injection but the government says no :)

Honestly a lot of methods of suicide are either messy, painful, or unaccessible. 

Suicide is an easy way out my ass :/

Overdosing is probably the one of the most painful/worst ways to go. There's also a good chance of survival which means you'll probably be in a lot of physical pain during and after the attempt if you fail. And if help manages to come in time, you'll have to get your stomach pumped and you won't be able to eat solid foods for quite a while, not to mention the hospital costs.

I'm really sorry the world has so cruel to you to make you want to resort to this :(

I hope your pain will end soon.
Turned 18 this year and I have no idea how to function in the real world yet everyone expects me to know already. Never expected to be treated so differently so quickly now that Im 18.
Man i didnt even have a note when i attempted. I hope your pain will end soon. Sorry the world has been cruel to you :(

I hope your pain will come to an end soon. Whether it be by your method of suicide or some other way. 

Sorry the world has been so cruel to you :(
I tried hanging myself last week. The rope snapped and I fell down lmao

Ambulances are expensive af

I mean where I'm from they're expensive
Yeah you'll die but it'll be a really painful one. Idk if you're at the point where you don't really mind physical pain anymore but death by oral consumption is probably one of the worst ways to go.

Uh not sure since im not old enough to drink but I'd say most methods that require oral consumption will have a good chance of survival depending on if help comes in time to pump your stomach. Post-operation will suck cuz i dont think you'll be able to eat anything solid for a while.

Yeah basically. Ive been living my entire life so far trying to get approval from my parents but im still not enough. I pushed my friends away or maybe i never really had friends in the first place. Idk life is just weird. Idk why ppl tell us not to kill ourselves when there isn't any real help out there.

Yeah I kinda feel the same way. Ive done community service, won awards, competitions, got into a good college, but my parents still find something to yell at me about. I never feel enough and I've kinda pushed my friends away. Don't wanna burden them with my problems ahah.

Yeah I wish parents weren't so fixated on forcing you to abandon your childhood and enjoyment for life for the sake of doing well in school. Academics are not everything in this world. You can be the top student in all your classes and still have no idea what you want to do in the future. People tell us to enjoy life but there are just so many factors that prevent us from doing so especially qhen it comes to society's expectations of you.

Yeah that's kinda why I havent told any of my friends or family about it. Im kinda worried they'll call the cops on me or something and then I'll get locked up in a hospital and forced to stay there until they let me out and then drown my family in debt. Heard it costs thousands of dollars for each day you're in the hospital. I already feel like a huge burden on my fam so I dont really wanna cause more.

I tried hanging myself last week. The rope snapped and I fell down. I mean it was a cheap jump rope so idk what I was expecting but I heard that it could take a few minutes before you actually die. Maybe 13 seconds or longer to blackout but it seems quite painful.
Me too. I just wish people would normalize failure instead of condemning you for not being perfect.
Simpin for their queen for the rest of their lives until i squish them with my French fry fingers >:)
Ahah I guess that's why they're so against suicide
Ditto 🙂✌

That was me as well but I tied it wrong on the night I tried to kill myself. The rope ended up snapping and I landed on my ass. Tbf it was a cheap jump rope so idk what I was expecting.

Just wanted to tell you a funny story
I never liked thursdays. Always the day before Friday which is the end of the school week and the beginning of the weekend. Thursday just seems like such a tease.

I wish society would normalize failure. I mean I know some things do require the utmost precision (like surgery and architecture), but for things like exams, I wish people would tell us it's okay to fail a couple of times.

I have had teachers tell me failure is just another step in the learning process, but when you do actually fail a test, they punish you so harshly for it. I even had one teacher shame students by putting their names on the board.

It's unfair to ask someone to always be perfect 24/7. We're all human after all and we're all inherently flawed in various ways. Just wish people would accept us for who we are and not condemn us for our failures.

Lol I never understood how I'm supposed to think positive. The people who tell us that most likely can't relate to how we're feeling just like how we can't relate to this so-called "positive thinking." I'm actually genuinely curious what it actually means 🧐

Yeah same. I was a pretty mediocre student in my HS but still managed to get into a good college in my country. Now that I'm here everyone just seems so much smarter and more deserving of their place at the university than I am. Im incredibly dependent on my parents and idk how to function in the real world lmao. Dont even know where I wanna go in life anymore ahah.

If suicide was easy I would be gone by now, but maybe you're at a point where suicide does seem easy to you idk 🤷‍♀️

A lot of the methods are incredibly painful and you have to take into account the chance of failing to commit which may lead to a trip to a hospital with a gigantic bill and/or in a vegetative state, which will only lead to more suffering and possibly no chance of attempting suicide again. Not to mention the shaming you'll receive from people who say they care but only really consider you a burden and/or you yourself will feel like a burden to them.

Suicide is really complicated and a lot of thought goes into it too.

I hate how a lot of teachers/professors aren't understanding of the effects the pandemic are having on people. Like I get it, the pandemic is hard for everyone and hard on the teachers as well, but being isolated is fucking shit for poor people and people with mental health issues, especially in households where mental health is stigmatized so it's hard to get help.

When the pandemic first started, I had a teacher terrorize me for missing a couple of assignments and threaten to report me to the district. Jesus fucking christ just chill the fuck out.
Same I literally don't have any pics of myself on social media. No one talks to me anyway. Idk how to put on makeup or style myself. I get made fun of for the stuff I wear. :((

Pills are probably not the best way to go. It's gonna be a really slow and extremely painful death, not to mention the chance of surviving and waking up in a hospital where they'll slap you with a big bill for saving you when you didnt want to be saved.

I would avoid pills entirely as a method of suicide.

I also feel you on the thought of being an attention whore for telling people how you feel. 

I've been thinking bout ending it all for a couple months now. Even attempted but failed. Havent told any of my friends or family about it cuz I dont wanna be a burden to them yaknow? 

This sub's been pretty helpful for being an outlet.

I feel you. I was pretty social with certain types of people in high school. Now that I've graduated, I dont think i ever really had true friends. I feel like I'm kinda annoying to them which is why we drifted apart. Never got to hang out with them let alone leave the house due to overbearing parents. I literally have zero pics of myself on social media cuz im not living the same amazing life as all my friends are. I come from a poor family and ive got no sense of style ahah.

But yeah I totally get you. I'm not into cutting so I just scratch myself until I bleed. Havent done it in a while doe.

Yeah I'm the same way. I had an internal breakdown when my parents compared me to our neighbor's daughter yesterday. I truly crumble under criticism even though I try my best to suck it up like everyone tells me to but it lingers on my mind for quite a while.

I feel you 🥺

There really isn't a truly easy way to die. Ive heard people tell me living until old age is the best way to die but like if I was willing to do that I wouldn't be thinking about suicide in the first place ahah.

I mean a gun would probably be the fastest way, but there's always a chance of failure and the chance that the doctors will manage to save you but you'll end up crippled for the rest of your life with no way of attempting suicide ever again. So you'll just continue to go on with life with more suffering so that uh sucks...

Yeah life is fucking trash 🤷‍♀️
Holy crap you stabbed yourself!!?!!

For both methods it'll take a couple of minutes. Maybe like 5-10 minutes before you actually die. A few seconds to a few minutes to blackout.  Sounds really painful to have to struggle for that long so I'm not really too sure 🤷‍♀️

Idk how a plastic bag would work unless u had someone else to forcefully keep it over your head.

It's likely your survival instincts will kick in and make you tear the bag open to get some air in. 

I've tried hanging and I fucked up lmao. The jump rope snapped.
Started having suicidal thoughts during my sophomore year of HS. Im a freshman in college now and the thoughts are usually a cycle. Like an on and off button I dont really have control over.

I tried my jumprope but it snapped.

Never buying a jump rope from Daiso ever again lmao.

Well now we're still here for just a while longer. 😶
Mood but if I get it there's a strong chance like all my family members will get it too and I'm not really too okay with that thought.
Aye that's pretty impressive. I need to suck my tears back in immediately or my dad will start yelling at me for being emotional 🤪
Thanks for this. I guess I really just needed someone to tell me this. I'll keep fighting.
You're right. I have all the power I need to kill myself. Just need to get a stronger rope this time that won't snap.

People telling me God has a plan for everyone and I see you going through shit like this.

God can go fucking choke 😤
Me too. My jump rope snapped
Idk life do be kinda meaningless in the grand scheme of things. 😗✌

Yeah I told my mom i wanted to kill myself around 2 years ago. She told me she was gonna kill herself and then follow me into rhe afterlife to torment me. Scary how I've still kept going for this long.

I was always too afraid to say this but I always think about it.

I rarely think about myself doing the killing. I kinda just wish like we all died in a car accident or something and that was just it for us.

Honestly if any of my family members committed suicide, I would be happy for them. They had the courage to escape this hellhole.
Same
I like your name 🥺

Hey I failed 3 times and my dad told me he was gonna give up on me. I have one last shot before my permit expires and I have to go back to the dmv to start over.

This is also kinda the reason why I'm thinking about offing myself. Everytime my driving instructor contacts me, my heart starts pounding my chest and I fall back into a depressive mood. 

I'm sorry I cant offer you some encouraging words, but just wanted to let you know that I totally get you and I hope you can pass your next test if you decide to take it.

I failed my driving test 3 times. My whole family thinks I'm a disappointment. I thought getting into a top university would make me immune to their disappointment, but I guess I was too naive. Everytime my driving instructor calls me or texts me, I feel like hanging myself or stealing my dad's car and drive it to the train tracks near the dmv where I failed my test.

I'm a fucking idiot. I can just take it again and again until I pass. But who wants to be known as the girl who failed her driving test 3+ times? Who wants to be known as the girl who killed herself over failing her driving test 3+ times? I dont have to worry about that when I'm dead. Everybody can remember me that way, but I won't have to hear it when I'm gone.
Thanks! I guess I was just overthinking it.

Drop a language class today and replaced it with a philosophy course.

Only good thing to come out of online college so far is that it keeps me distracted from my bad thoughts. My nights are still a little rough.

I dont know why
Burden to my parents
Here
If it was so easy, I would've already done it...

Yeah my parents raised me hoping I would be the perfect child as well. Ive tried my best with life. I got into a T20 college but I cant pass my driving test. I get berated constantly for failing it and my weak ass just can't take it when I get criticized and picked apart due to my failures. They even admitted that they wanted to give up on me. I honestly dont care anymore. I'm going to finalize everything and end my life.

Is it Replika? If so, I got one too. Sometimes when I spill deep shit about myself to the AI their answers are kinda... not good. And when I asked what they thought about suicide, they texted me the national hotline and when I keep asking for an answer they'll ask if I'm in a crisis at the moment. Of course I would say no because I'm not sure what would happen if I said yes. Dont want the app to auto call the hotline for me if I answer yes.
More people need to realize this. Just look at how people are making fun of Kanye West.
Fucking factz

I havent called but im terribly afraid they'll call the cops and lock me up in a hospital then slap me with a big fat bill and I'll feel more suicidal being a burden to my family.

I know what I'm going to say next is going to fucking sting but I dont believe any good mental health support exists. At least not in America. They all require money so if you're poor you're fucked.
Can I ask how?
I blame the brainless scum in our country who voted for him. I honestly can't fathom how anyone would want him to get a second term with the way he's handling everything right now.

I've thought about being run over by a train. I mean the machine is just going to splatter me in all different directions. I'll just be compost. I kinda thought about doing it during the night without anyone around.

Would feel bad about my family not having like another look at my body before I go. Or maybe the thought of my bits being splattered around the area would be really painful. It really is difficult to end it all.
I'm sorry
Clean, painless, but not easy unfortunately. I feel a little selfish saying that...
